name: -8 AN to 3/4" NPT 90 Degree Elbow Adapter
title: -8 AN to 3/4" NPT 90 Degree Elbow Adapter
description:
ColorFittings AN to NPT 90 Degree Elbow Adapter Fittings are precision-engineered to connect AN flare fittings to NPT ports, providing a secure, leak-free solution for fuel, oil, coolant, and power steering plumbing systems.



Our AN to NPT Adapters are manufactured to provide a perfect fit and seal when paired with ColorFittings AN fittings, which are specifically engineered for use with E85, ethanol-based fuels, and race fuels. When combined with the nylon or stainless steel braided hose, these adapters deliver reliable performance and clean routing for any high-performance plumbing system.



For best installation results, Color-Fittings strongly recommend using the AN Fitting Assembly Tools, which help prevent fitting damage and ensure proper hose and fitting alignment. Please reference the installation video and fitting guide for proper assembly techniques and torque recommendations.



Looking to complete your system? Explore the full range of AN fittings, NPT adapters, braided hose, and fitting assembly tools.
